summary: Cavite 6th District representative with 24 principal-authored bills. Authored an anti-dynasty ban, a call for a constitutional convention, a procurement act amendment and a PAGCOR host-share bill. Co-authored PWD assistance, a universal social pension and the national minimum wage.
caveat: Economic score rests entirely on co-authored bills. Constitutional convention is a charter-change route with no stated content, scored neutral.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Co-authored universal social pension and PWD assistance (-3, social provision) and national minimum wage (-2, labor). All co-authored; no authored economic bills reviewed.
